title: Analyzer diagnostics must still be reported when SuppressSourceGeneration = true
intent: Turning off source generation must not silence the analyzer; it regressed in 3.1.1.
functional: Analyzer reports its diagnostics when SuppressSourceGeneration is true
Generator still emits nothing when SuppressSourceGeneration is true
nonFunctional: No change to diagnostics when SuppressSourceGeneration is false
issueBody:
#### Bug description

The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true. This has happened since version 3.1.1. It still worked in 3.1.0.
